According to industrial knowledge, what is the minimum requirement for the length of insulating sleeving on an unused wire relative to the wire diameter?

Options:
A. It must extend at least 2 wire diameters beyond the end of the wire.
B. It must extend onto the wire insulation for a minimum of 4 wire diameters or 6 mm [0.24 in], whichever is greater.
C. It must be folded back and tied into the wire bundle.
D. It must extend straight down the length of the wire bundle.

Answer with the option letter only.
B

<image>According to industrial knowledge and [Figure 1], which of the following conditions would classify the assembly shown as a "Defect – Class 1,2,3"?

Options:
A. The staking material adheres to the component for less than 50% of its length.
B. The staking material is not cured.
C. The staking material is applied to an area to be soldered.
D. The staking material does not have a continuous adhesion fillet to the mounting surface and component body.

Answer with the option letter only.
D
